projects.name: CV Website (WIP)
projects.description: This website that you are seeing now. It is a website I built to showcase my skills and experience. It is built using React, Next.js, and TypeScript. The localizations/translations are done by myself (without AI) and are stored via .json files. The website itself is stored on github and is deployed on Vercel.

projects.name: Maze Generator (WIP)
projects.description: A program that builds a random maze given a set size. It uses Java and JavaFX to create the maze and display it. The maze itself is generated recursively, starting with a random solution paths, then adding random walls around it.

projects.name: Wi-Fi Status Monitor
projects.description: A program that monitors the status of your Wi-Fi connection. It is very straightforward, in that the only functionality it does is to display a toast notification whenever your Wi-Fi connection status changes. It uses Python and I built it as a way to test making fully executable programs.
